title: ATM Fee Incident Tracker
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:transaction
| where category="ATM Fee"
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as fee_events, sum(amount_usd) as fees_usd by account_name _time
| where fee_events>0
| sort - fees_usd
description: Uses Plaid transaction history telemetry to monitor when and where ATM fees are still occurring in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for avoidable bank-fee patterns that are easy to miss, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid transaction history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It frames when and where ATM fees are still occurring so you can spot avoidable bank-fee patterns that are easy to miss before it becomes annoying.
